articles.title: Ex-OpenAI's Leopold Aschenbrenner bets big on crypto miners for his $13.6 billion AI play
articles.snippet: Aschenbrenner is shorting Nvidia and AMD in favor of bitcoin miners that own the electricity and data centers needed to fuel the next phase of the AI boom.

articles.title: Deploi Launches Direct Issuance Infrastructure for Private Credit on Polygon, Secures ISIN Allocations from Nasdaq CSD
articles.snippet: EUR 1 billion note programme planned for 2026 following completion of global issuance infrastructure by the end of Q3 2026.

articles.title: Senate crypto bill at risk beyond midterms if not passed by August: NYDIG
articles.snippet: NYDIG’s Greg Cipolaro says the Senate’s crypto market structure bill is at risk of failing if it cannot clear a floor vote by August.

articles.title: Polymarket Users Spur Insider Trading Suspicions With $2.4 Million in Iran Prediction Wins
articles.snippet: Interlinked Polymarket accounts have made millions betting on U.S. military actions in Iran—and won 98% of the time, analysts say.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum ETFs Bleed as Crypto Funds Shed $1.07 Billion, Ending 6-Week Win Streak
articles.snippet: Bitcoin ETFs bore the brunt of a geopolitically driven sell-off, CoinShares said, though altcoin funds largely held their ground.
